name: War Spawn
body:
Also known as Dread Marshals and War Bringers, these are Ares’ most favored champions. These warlords have spent years on military campaigns and participated in massive battles. They are among the highest ranking cult officials and they lead armies for kings and city-states.

Role: War Spawns are formidable warriors infused with the chaotic essence of Ares, embodying bloodlust and an insatiable desire for battle. Clad in heavy armor and wielding devastating weapons, they charge into the heart of combat, instilling fear and chaos among their foes. With their mastery of martial prowess and destructive spells, War Spawn strike fear into the hearts of their enemies, leaving a trail of destruction in their wake.

Alignment: War Spawn revel in the chaos and brutality of war, embodying the unyielding wrath of Ares. They are driven by their bloodlust and lack any sense of order. As such, War Spawn are typically of Chaotic alignment, embracing the destructive and anarchic forces of the world. They reject the notions of law and order, and their actions are driven solely by their insatiable hunger for battle and conquest.

Hit Die: d10.

Requirements

To qualify to become a War Spawn, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any chaotic.

Base Attack Bonus: +8.

Skills: Intimidate 8 ranks, Knowledge (war) 8 ranks.

Special: Chosen Enemy and War Cry special abilities.

Class Skills

The War Spawn’s class skills are Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Knowledge (war) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier

Table 2: The War Spawn
Level	Base Attack	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells per Day
1	+1	+1	+0	+1	Ferocious assault	+1 level of existing class
2	+2	+1	+1	+1	Martial magic	+1 level of existing class
3	+3	+2	+1	+2	Unyielding assault	+1 level of existing class
4	+4	+2	+1	+2	Chosen enemy +1 per day	+1 level of existing class
5	+5	+3	+2	+3	Avatar of Ares	+1 level of existing class
Class Features

War Spawn have the following class features.

Ferocious Assault (Ex)

When the War Spawn reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they can immediately move up to 10 feet and make a melee weapon attack against another creature within reach.

Martial Magic (Sp)

At 2nd level, a War Spawn can select one of the following cleric domains: Chaos, Death, Destruction, War. The War Spawn can cast the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th level spells listed for the selected domain once each per day as a spell-like ability. The War Spawn’s caster level for these spells is equal to her total character level.

Unyielding Assault (Su)

By 3rd level, whenever a War Spawn takes the full attack action against a chosen enemy, she can make one extra attack each round against that chosen enemy.

Chosen Enemy (Su)

Upon reaching 4th level, a War Spawn can use her Chosen Enemy ability one additional time per day.

Avatar of Ares (Su)

At 5th level, once per day as an immediate action, a War Spawn can call upon Ares to imbue her with the tenacity of a legendary warrior. For 10 minutes, the War Spawn gains a +4 enhancement bonus to her Strength and Constitution scores and DR5/-. During this time, whenever the War Spawn fails a saving throw roll, she can immediately reroll the save, potentially turning a failed save into a success.
